accounts.email_hint: Type the whole address. Part of an address finds nothing.
accounts.email_invalid: Type one whole email address, such as name@example.org.

security.intro: Who holds senior access, who was given it or lost it, who signed in as another member, and where sign-ins are failing. Across every community.
security.privacy_note: People and communities are shown by name. Email addresses and internet addresses are never shown here.
security.load_error_title: We couldn't load the security page just now

two_step.title: Two-step sign-in on senior accounts

failed.title: Failed sign-ins
failed.note: Two separate counts, by community and by the hour. “Failed password checks”: someone tried to sign in and the password was wrong. “Refused by the lock-out”: after too many tries, the attempt was turned away before any password was checked. The two are never added together. Each count keeps only a number, nothing about the person or where they signed in from. Figures are counted in whole hours, so each one can include up to an hour more.
failed.nothing_counted: Nothing has been counted yet. Failed sign-ins are counted from the day this count was switched on.
failed.empty: No failed or refused sign-ins in the last 24 hours.
failed.col_failed: Failed password checks in the last 24 hours:
failed.recent_note: Which internet addresses are being tried right now. The platform keeps these details for only about 20 minutes, and forgets an address's failures when it next signs in successfully. Sign-ins through the accessible site all arrive from one address.
failed.addresses_15m: Different internet addresses in the last 15 minutes
failed.most_from_one_15m: Most from one address in the last 15 minutes
failed.col_refused: Refused by the lock-out in the last 24 hours:

access.title: Senior access given and removed
access.note: Not shown here: platform team changes made directly in the database, which are not recorded; and tenant super admin access taken from everyone at once when a community stops being a hub.
access.empty: No senior access was given or removed in the last {{days}} days.

impersonation.title: Signed in as another member
impersonation.note: An admin can sign in as a member to help them. Every time that happened is listed here.

glance.read_only_note: This page only shows the switches. To change one, open that community's own admin panel.

glance.modules_note: The parts every community starts with. A community can still switch one off.

notices.title: Notices
notices.intro: Write a short notice once and every community's admins see it at the top of the admin panel. Members and brokers never see it.

form.until_before_from: The end must be later than the start.
form.can_close_hint: If this is off, the notice stays until it finishes or you end it.
form.reshow_note: If you change the words, the kind or the link, people who closed this notice will see it again.

access_review.intro: Go through every senior account and say whether it should keep its access. A review is due at least every 90 days.

access_review.never: No review has been recorded yet.
access_review.last_review_erased: Last review: {{date}}, recorded by an erased account.

access_review.note_hint: Up to {{max}} characters. Only the platform team sees it.

push_notifications.title: Push notifications
push_notifications.intro: How many notifications were sent to members’ phones and browsers, by day and by community. “Accepted by the push service” means the service took the notification, not that a phone showed it. Some kinds of notification are sent without being recorded here (event reminders, emergency alerts and some others), so the real numbers are at least these.
push_notifications.timezone_note: Days run in the server’s time (UTC).
push_notifications.kept_note: Each record is kept for {{count, number}} days, then the nightly clean-up deletes it.
push_notifications.load_error_title: The push notification figures could not be loaded
push_notifications.not_available: Not available: the record of push notifications could not be read. This does not mean none were sent.
push_notifications.by_community_note: Totals for the whole period. “Nobody to send to” is shown per day only.
push_notifications.no_community_note: Notifications recorded without a community. They are included in the daily figures.

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.intro: The last deployments and rollbacks this server recorded, newest first. Times are shown in your own time zone.
deployments.watch_note: The 30-minute watch for errors that follows each deployment is not recorded here.
deployments.load_error_title: The deployment record could not be loaded
deployments.no_record_title: This server keeps no record of deployments
deployments.no_record_text: Only the live server keeps one, so on a developer's computer this is expected.
deployments.skipped: Lines in the record that could not be read and were skipped: {{count, number}}

errors.title: Recent errors
errors.intro: How many errors the error service recorded for each part of the platform.
errors.counts_only: These are counts only. The details of each error stay in the error service.
errors.kept_note: Figures are kept for five minutes. "Check again" asks the error service now.
errors.load_error_title: Recent errors could not be loaded
errors.could_not_read: The error service could not be read for this part. That is not the same as no errors.

figure.unresolved: Unresolved problems seen in the last 14 days

not_connected.title: Not connected
not_connected.needed: The error service gives these figures only to a read-only access key of its own, stored on this server. That has not been done.
not_connected.settings: Switching it on needs four settings on the server: the read-only key (SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN_MONITOR), the organisation (SENTRY_ORG), the project number or numbers (SENTRY_PROJECT_PHP, and if wanted SENTRY_PROJECT_REACT and SENTRY_PROJECT_WEBUK), and the address for the organisation's region (SENTRY_API_BASE). The address is needed for any organisation outside the US region.
not_connected.decision: Whether to do it is a decision for the platform's owner.
not_connected.meanwhile: Until then, the nightly error report you already receive is the place to look.

errors.check_refused: Checking again was refused: too many checks in a minute. The figures below are from before.
errors.could_not_read_any: The error service answered, but its figures could not be read. That is not the same as no errors.

clean_up_jobs.title: Clean-up jobs
clean_up_jobs.intro: The scheduled jobs that delete old data. For each: what it deletes, how often it runs, when it last ran successfully and when it last failed. Times are shown in your own time zone.
clean_up_jobs.records_note: Records for most of these jobs only start from the day this page went live. Until a job next runs it shows "No record yet": that can take up to a day, or a week for a weekly job. Jobs run by the every-minute runner keep their record for 30 days only.
clean_up_jobs.load_error_title: The clean-up jobs could not be loaded

performance_prune.name: Speed measurements
performance_prune.deletes: Deletes the platform's own speed measurements once they are older than the set number of days.

retention_enforce.name: Community keeping rules
retention_enforce.deletes: Deletes or anonymises data older than each community's own keeping settings allow.

prune_logs.name: Old log records
prune_logs.deletes: Deletes old rows from the platform's own logs, such as scheduled job runs, missing pages, activity, partner connections and push notifications.

prune_match_notifications.name: Match email records
prune_match_notifications.deletes: Deletes the records of which match emails were sent, once they are older than 30 days.

purge_message_copies.name: Message copies kept for safeguarding
purge_message_copies.deletes: Deletes the copies of messages kept for safeguarding review once each community's keeping period has passed.

federation_purge_external_logs.name: Partner request logs
federation_purge_external_logs.deletes: Deletes the logs of requests to and from partner platforms once they pass their age limit.

federation_prune_aggregate_logs.name: Shared figures log
federation_prune_aggregate_logs.deletes: Deletes the records of partners asking for shared figures once they are older than 12 months.

groups_prune_exports.name: Group download files
groups_prune_exports.deletes: Removes group download files once they expire, and deletes old records of them.

cleanup.name: Daily tidy-up
cleanup.deletes: Deletes expired reset links, sign-in keys and blocks on newsletters, sent notifications and scheduled job records older than 30 days, and old match results.

cleanup_sessions.name: Old sign-ins
cleanup_sessions.deletes: Deletes sign-ins unused for more than a day and sign-in records that have expired.

story_cleanup.name: Expired stories
story_cleanup.deletes: Hides stories that have expired and deletes their pictures and videos.

gdpr_export_cleanup.name: Personal data download files
gdpr_export_cleanup.deletes: Deletes the files with a member's personal data once their download link has expired.

abuse_cleanup.name: Closed abuse alerts
abuse_cleanup.deletes: Deletes abuse alerts that were resolved or dismissed more than 90 days ago.

gamification_cleanup.name: Old points and badge records
gamification_cleanup.deletes: Deletes points notices older than 7 days, campaign awards older than a year and badge figures older than two years.

purge_verification_sessions.name: Old identity checks
purge_verification_sessions.deletes: Deletes finished or expired identity checks older than 180 days. The record of what happened in each check is kept.

clean_up_jobs.finished_only: This job records that it finished, not that every step worked.
clean_up_jobs.steps_failed: Steps that failed on the last run: {{count, number}}

search_rebuild.started: The rebuild is waiting to start. This list updates by itself.

agreements.title: Agreements and renewals
agreements.intro: The agreements the platform has with communities and others. The next renewal comes first. Any agreement that renews within {{days}} days, or whose renewal date has passed, is marked, and the home page shows a reminder.
agreements.private_note: Contact names and email addresses are shown only on this page, to the platform team. They are not kept in the activity record.
agreements.load_error_title: We couldn't load the agreements just now
agreements.empty_text: Add one to be reminded before it renews.
agreements.ended_text: Ended agreements stay on record. There is no delete: an agreement entered by mistake is ended too.
